title: Introducing Muse Spark Open, The Most Capable US Open‑Weight Model to Date | Meta AI Research
summary: Meta has released Muse Spark Open, an 816B-parameter multimodal mixture-of-experts model featuring a 1M-token context window and optimized for agentic coding. The model supports text, image, video, and audio inputs, and is available for local deployment on Apple Silicon via MLX as well as major serving engines like vLLM and SGLang.

title: HybridAgent toggles latent reasoning with tools, cuts cost 3.7x | AI Weekly
summary: Researchers introduced HybridAgent, a framework featuring a lightweight toggle that switches mid-generation between silent latent reasoning and text-based tool execution. The approach achieves a 10.4% performance gain over standard frontier LLM agents across 11 benchmarks while significantly reducing token consumption and inference latency.

title: UltraBERT: One Encoder for Classification and Retrieval
summary: Researchers released UltraBERT, a new family of English encoders featuring native 32K context lengths and a decoupled dual-head architecture that overcomes the historical trade-off between classification and retrieval performance. The release includes pre-trained encoders at 150M and 380M parameters alongside an embedder model that scores top marks on MTEB.

title: Introducing Superfluid: the local-AI native LLM server for multi-agent inference - DEV Community
summary: Superfluid is a new open-source (Apache-2.0) local LLM inference server built specifically for running multiple agent workloads concurrently on a single machine. It features preemption for interactive chat requests, zero-loss logging to survive worker crashes, shared prompt caching, and multi-device private fleet networking.

title: Nvidia releases Kumo Tabular, an open foundation model for tabular prediction
summary: Nvidia has released Kumo Tabular, an open foundation model for tabular data that performs zero-shot classification and regression in a single forward pass without the need for manual feature engineering or retraining. Available on Hugging Face under an open commercial license, the Transformer-based models leverage column, row, and in-context attention to bypass traditional gradient-boosted tree workflows. Evaluations show it ranking competitively on major tabular benchmarks while offering substantial inference speedups.

title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Scout: Frontier Open-Weights Mixture-of-Depths Architecture with Native 1M-Token Context Window
summary: Meta FAIR has released Llama 4 Scout, a 105B total parameter model utilizing dynamic Mixture-of-Depths routing with 24B active parameters per token. It supports a native 1M-token context window with zero RoPE-frequency degradation and is available on Hugging Face with native runtime integration.

title: Tsinghua Shenzhen releases VeriLoop E2, a 27B model with evidence-governed reasoning for code and science – FreeLLM
summary: Tsinghua University's Shenzhen International Graduate School has released VeriLoop E2, an open-weight 27-billion parameter model licensed under Apache 2.0 for software engineering, mathematics, and physics. The system introduces VeriLoop-Governed Recurrence, separating candidate generation from deterministic external verification so reasoning progress is retained only when evidence improves. Compatible with vLLM serving, the model supports a 262K context window and scores 76.2% on SWE-bench Pro alongside 98.3% on AIME 2026.
